cds.title: Lawrence Technological University Common Data Set 2025-2026 (PDF)

ipeds_ef.title: IPEDS Fall Enrollment 2023 (EF2023A): undergraduate total and U.S. nonresident headcount

stats.notes: From the Common Data Set (fall 2025): 3,412 applicants, 2,764 admitted, 379 enrolled (369 full-time + 10 part-time). The Common Data Set does not report international applicants or admits and gives no in-state/out-of-state split. 44.7% of enrolled first-years sent SAT scores and 4.2% sent ACT scores. No class rank reported. Undergraduate enrollment is 2,661 (all undergraduates); the number of international undergraduates is not shown (the nonresident cells are not reliably readable from the PDF). Student-faculty ratio 11:1 from the Common Data Set.

cost.notes: From the Common Data Set (2025-26): nonresident-alien tuition equals the standard private tuition ($43,440 for 15 credits per term); fees $2,400; on-campus room and board $12,484; books $1,874; other costs $2,946 (transportation $2,528 is not included in other costs). 127 undergraduate degree-seeking nonresident aliens received aid from the college (need-based or non-need-based, the PDF does not say which), averaging $12,824. The tuition page shows an undated annual estimate of $47,850 tuition and fees (30 credits), $60,830 total
